_about: A regional dex as a VIEW over the one global roster (List 21, #198) — never a second roster. The view stores exactly one thing (an ordering list of roster ids) and derives everything else. OWNER RULING (Jamar, 2026-10-27): regional order (R2 #1-6) is view ordering only, NOT the roster number (#197 assigns numbers globally, in lock order); locked-but-undiscovered species display as SILHOUETTES in the Mochiioteca until discovered (Pokemon-style), joining the silhouette-discovery system (List 1, item 3).
consumers_share_one_derivation: this view, the Mochiioteca screen classes (#149), and the atlas region pages (#137) all read the SAME membership + discovery derivation. A consumer computing discovery privately is a defect wherever found.
counts: per-region completion (kept-in-view / locked-in-view) DERIVED at read time per #14's counts-are-computed law. No tallies stored in the view; no per-region anything stored on the roster.
disagreement_rule: ordered-but-not-present renders nothing; present-but-unordered appends after the ordered rows in roster-number order. Either disagreement is a data-lane flag — never a crash, never a silent fix.

entry_by_state.never-met: the silhouette (List 1 item 3's asset family + discovery grammar), the roster number, the regional position — a shape, not a name; no display name is shown (the display law)
entry_by_state.seen_or_kept: the entry as #14's completion loop defines it; every visible string a display-name lookup under the display-layer naming law (regional display names included)

membership: DERIVED at read time: species is in the view iff present in the region — #144's cross-region presence projection (range maps #102 over habitat/spawn data #7) unioned with kept/story presence from roster records. A species in two regions appears in both views with ONE record.
open_register: every region's ordering list beyond the inherited Region 1 presentation (design-lane curation)
whether the silhouette row shows the roster number, the regional position, or both (the ruling fixes the silhouette, not its furniture)
the name-reveal beat's exact staging at seen (owned by #3/#14's grammar)

two_axes.axis_1_roster: GLOBAL — locked (#197) or not in the world at all; one fact, true for everyone, changed only by a lock act
two_axes.axis_2_discovery: PER-RANGER — never-met -> seen -> kept (#14's states), computed from that Ranger's own facts
two_axes.binding_rule: no consumer may collapse the axes. An UNLOCKED species appears in NO Ranger's dex in any form — not even as a silhouette. Silhouettes show the roster's LOCKED shape to a Ranger who has not met its members; they are never a teaser for uncanonised content.

view_record.order: [roster ids in the region's curatorial presentation sequence] — references only; asserts nothing about presence; holds no species facts
